description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Caitlyn''' sets a visible trap at the target location that is [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area for 1 second after being placed.
description.text: Active: Caitlyn sets a visible trap at the target location that is untargetable and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants sight of the area for 1 second after being placed.

description2.raw: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Yordle Snap Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.
description2.text: Caitlyn periodically stocks a Yordle Snap Trap charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.

description3.raw: The next enemy champion that springs the trap is [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]] for 1.5 seconds and [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealed]] for 3 seconds, as well as takes additional damage from the ''[[File:Caitlyn Headshot.png|20xpx|border|link=Caitlyn#Headshot|An icon for Caitlyn's ability Headshot]] [[Caitlyn#Headshot|Headshot]]'' granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further ''Yordle Snap Traps'' for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.
description3.text: The next enemy champion that springs the trap is rooted for 1.5 seconds and revealed for 3 seconds, as well as takes additional damage from the Headshot granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further Yordle Snap Traps for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.

leveling2.raw:
'''Maximum Number of Traps:'''
3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5

leveling3.raw:

35 / 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 (+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * Multiple armed traps on the same location will spring all at once if an enemy steps on one of them.
notes.text: Multiple armed traps on the same location will spring all at once if an enemy steps on one of them.
